events.question: How many customers upgraded their plan in April 2026?

plan.headline: Counts distinct customer organizations whose subscription ended with an upgrade during April 2026, plus the monthly trend and plan breakdown for context.

metrics.title: Customers upgraded in April 2026
metrics.description: Number of distinct organizations with at least one subscription closed with cancel_reason 'upgrade' whose canceled_at falls within the selected date range.

metrics.title: Upgrades per week
metrics.description: Distinct organizations upgrading in each week of the selected date range, based on the date the old subscription row was closed.

metrics.title: Upgrades by previous plan
metrics.description: Distinct organizations upgrading in the selected range, grouped by the plan they upgraded from (the plan on the closed subscription row).

assumptions.label: Date range
assumptions.rationale: The question asks about April 2026, so use that calendar month as inclusive custom dates.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Determines which day an upgrade falls on near month boundaries; UTC matches how timestamps are stored.

assumptions.label: Exclude test accounts
assumptions.rationale: The data dictionary says test, demo and load-test tenants should be excluded from business metrics.

assumptions.label: Count unit
assumptions.rationale: A customer is an organization, so an org that upgraded more than once is counted once rather than once per plan change.

events.sql: WITH upgrades AS (SELECT s.org_id, s.id AS subscription_id, COALESCE(p.name, 'Unknown plan') AS plan_name FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id LEFT JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id WHERE s.cancel_reason = 'upgrade' AND s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp at time zone :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)) SELECT plan_name AS label, CASE WHEN :count_unit::text = 'upgrade_events' THEN count(*) ELSE count(DISTINCT org_id) END AS value FROM upgrades GROUP BY plan_name ORDER BY value DESC, label LIMIT 20
events.explanation: Counts upgrade-closed subscriptions in the date range (in the chosen timezone, excluding test orgs if set), grouped by the plan being upgraded from, as distinct orgs or events per count_unit.

events.sql: WITH weeks AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('week', (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp), date_trunc('week', ((:date_range_end::date) - 1)::timestamp), interval '1 week') AS wk), upg AS (SELECT s.org_id, date_trunc('week', s.canceled_at AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text) AS wk FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id WHERE s.cancel_reason = 'upgrade' AND s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)), agg AS (SELECT wk, count(DISTINCT org_id) AS distinct_orgs, count(*) AS events FROM upg GROUP BY wk) SELECT w.wk::date AS x, COALESCE(CASE WHEN :count_unit::text = 'upgrade_events' THEN a.events ELSE a.distinct_orgs END, 0) AS y FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.wk = w.wk ORDER BY x
events.explanation: Counts upgrade-closed subscriptions per week (local timezone) within the range, distinct orgs or events per count_unit, excluding test orgs if set, with zero-filled weeks.

events.sql: WITH upgrades AS (SELECT s.org_id, s.id AS subscription_id FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id WHERE s.cancel_reason = 'upgrade' AND s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)), prev_upgrades AS (SELECT s.org_id, s.id AS subscription_id FROM northwind.subscriptions s JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id WHERE s.cancel_reason = 'upgrade' AND s.canceled_at IS NOT NULL AND s.canceled_at >= (:date_range_prev_start::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND s.canceled_at < (:date_range_prev_end::date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR o.is_test = false)) SELECT CASE WHEN :count_unit::text = 'upgrade_events' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM upgrades) ELSE (SELECT count(DISTINCT org_id) FROM upgrades) END AS value, CASE WHEN :count_unit::text = 'upgrade_events' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM prev_upgrades) ELSE (SELECT count(DISTINCT org_id) FROM prev_upgrades) END AS previous_value
events.explanation: Counts distinct orgs (or upgrade rows if count_unit is upgrade_events) with subscriptions closed as 'upgrade' in the date range in the chosen timezone, excluding test orgs, with the prior equal-length period for comparison.
